environment.description: Same service deployed behind an Application Load Balancer with AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached. The WebACL includes the AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_BODY rule in COUNT mode, and a custom rule group 'iot-payload-inspection' with priority 1 that uses a regex pattern set matching against the request body. The regex pattern set 'block-dynamic-eval-patterns' contains patterns: '(?i)\"expr\"\s*:', '(?i)\"dynamic\"\s*:\s*true', and '(?i)(__import__|eval|exec|compile|os\.|subprocess)'. The custom rule uses AND logic requiring ALL three patterns to match before BLOCK action. Additionally, the ALB has a listener rule that routes /api/v1/device/message only when the X-Device-Cert-Serial header is present (populated by mTLS termination at the ALB), returning 403 otherwise. The WAF also has AWS-AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet enabled in BLOCK mode which covers Log4j/JNDI patterns but the eval patterns are handled by the custom rule group.

waf_rules.name: AWS-AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
waf_rules.note: SizeRestrictions in count-only for large telemetry payloads
